audit.why: Early is Viktor-favored (600-range E poke vs 750 Q, dodgeable Nevermove), 6 evens it via Demonic Ascension sustain, late favors Viktor again. Page prose reflects this.
Spikes correctly identified: Viktor Lost Chapter/Luden's + augments; Swain level 6 (Demonic Ascension) and first-item Blackfire Torch/Liandry's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated/stale ability names: 'Death Ray' (Viktor E is Hextech Ray per kit), 'Nevermore' (Swain E is Nevermove), 'Chaos Storm' (Viktor R is Arcane Storm per kit text).
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names; suspectNames flagged Death Ray.
audit.corrected: Names corrected in edits; interactions stated: Q shield absorbs his Q bolts, W gravity field zones his 850-range E root, his 120s R is the all-in gate.

audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; real numbers exist in kits (R 120s, E 12s, W 17s).
Anti-heal into Swain's P/R sustain already present in report[8].t, covering the needs-antiheal missing interaction.

edits.before: You out-range Swain's Q double-bolt and can dodge his slow-moving E root from both directions: poke with Death Ray, deny his soul-fragment stacking, and shove him under tower before his sustain scales.
edits.after: You out-range Swain's Q double-bolt and can dodge his slow-moving E root from both directions: poke with Hextech Ray, deny his soul-fragment stacking, and shove him under tower before his sustain scales.

edits.before: Your Death Ray out-ranges Swain's Q and his E root is dodgeable, giving you the level-1 edge.
edits.after: Your Hextech Ray out-ranges Swain's Q and his E root is dodgeable, giving you the level-1 edge.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension gives Swain real dueling sustain and a Nevermore pull, so this is where his all-in tightens up; don't fight him inside his drain radius, use Chaos Storm to poke and disengage instead.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension gives Swain real dueling sustain and a Nevermove pull, so this is where his all-in tightens up; don't fight him inside his drain radius, use Arcane Storm to poke and disengage instead.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay in your favor as you shove him off farm, but at 6 his Demonic Ascension sustain closes the gap; poke him with Chaos Storm and never duel him inside his drain radius.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay in your favor as you shove him off farm, but at 6 his Demonic Ascension sustain closes the gap; poke him with Arcane Storm and never duel him inside his drain radius.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Arcane Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Cast Q on him before his Q bolts land — the shield eats the burst and the empowered auto pays it back; at rank 5 it is up every 5 seconds.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Chasing kills across the map bleeds the farm your augments run on — Swain's long-range W scouts your roam path anyway.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Gravity Field like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: 120s — once demon form drops he has no sustain for two minutes; that is your all-in window. - Nevermove (E) is 12s at rank 1 — trade while it is down. - Guard your 17s W like a fifth summoner; R only for kill windows.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: Q-shield trades on his last-hits win level 1 — his Q bolts hit your shield and the empowered auto walks away free.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Full kit favors you: W zones his E-root threat and E-Q-auto out-ranges his 750-range Q. Stack your first augment.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — you shove him off farm and out-poke his sustain pre-6. Laser every wave contact, bank Manaflow.

notes: Chart rule applied: content win[0/2/3] already read Viktor (matching packet levelChart), so full sides were moved alone with rewritten whys/ratings — no win[] no-ops added. 'Chaos Storm' is Viktor's pre-rework R name; kit text says Arcane Storm — corrected where encountered (phases[4].why, spikes[1].text, mid); other fields do not name the R. missingInteractions 'your-channel-punished' (Swain E cancels Viktor R channel) NOT written: Riot's R description mentions no channel, the channel flag looks like a derived-flag misfire, and I could not verify Viktor's R is interruptible. resistances-invalidated (Swain P percentHealth) left unwritten — Swain's P grants HP, it does not deal percent-health damage to Viktor; flag misfire.
